summary: Our app helps people get to learn more about space and making engineering decisions.  This app will have 4 parts; Moon crash, Rocket from Mars, Simulation, and Quiz. The app will make making engineering decisions feel more like a playable and interactive game. The game will also give the player 4 chances, 1 chance on each part.
details:
This project is beneficial because it simulates the actual life of someone in a spaceship. It functions as an interactive simulation controlled by on-screen buttons, guiding users through four distinct stages: Moon Crash, Rocket from Mars, Simulation, and Quiz. The intended impact of this project is to educate players about space survival and engineering decisions in an engaging, playable way.
To develop our website, our team used Python modules such as PyScript, along with HTML and Visual Studio Code. SI was also used to edit and debug the code. We deployed the live site using GitHub Pages, and we recorded our 30-second demo video using Screencast and Google Vids. Our project is creative because it turns complex space engineering challenges into a high-stakes, game experience. During development, our group had to carefully consider tight time pressure, limited available resources, and our team's current coding knowledge. *Edited with SI*
